Fix Java and Objective-C EMAPI Dart parity gaps. (#42)

## Summary
Fix Java and Objective-C EMAPI Dart parity gaps.

## Changes
- Add Java readNextReport handling that ACKs and emits reports without requiring a pending command response.
- Preserve Java pending command responses while consuming later active reports and update flow-control state before subsequent sends.
- Expose absent Java device MTU as null while retaining internal fallback MTU for transfers.
- Reject out-of-range unsigned integer and TLV helper inputs instead of truncating.
- Route Objective-C readNextReportWithError through emitReport and reject overflowing fileType values before TLV construction.

## Verification
- mvn -pl fruits/emapi test -DskipTests=false passed with 48 tests.
- just java passed across the Java reactor.
- git diff --check passed.
- Objective-C XCTest requires macOS/Xcode; xcodebuild is unavailable in this Linux lane.
